item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff to reach Wimbledon final
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Czech player Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon singles title
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to overcome Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final on Saturday.

item.title: Park Vista football team aims for state playoffs after strong 2025 finish
item.description: Park Vista Community High School's football team is building on late-season momentum as the Cobras set their sights on the state playoffs in 2026.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November with 6,000-seat design
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium this week, with groundbreaking anticipated in November at the Walton & One development along U.S. 1 and Walton Road.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with panoramic views
item.description: Built in 1860, the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb to the top rewards visitors with breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
